culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Toshinari Shiga. He had tricked Noriya's sense of time to help prove his alibi. The motive was that Hiroto was stalking Mika which caused her death. Shiga's sister had jumped into traffic in order to get away from her stalker, Hiroto, and was hit by a car. If Hiroto had called for an ambulance, and told them where she was she might've lived.

motive.quote: Shiga's sister had jumped into traffic in order to get away from her stalker, Hiroto, and was hit by a car.

method.quote: He had tricked Noriya's sense of time to help prove his alibi.

motive.zhHans: Shiga 的妹妹为了摆脱跟踪她的 Hiroto 而冲进车流，被车撞死。尽管她已经死了，Hiroto 仍然保留着他跟踪她时拍下的照片，在这些照片前面，他指责 Mika 之所以死是因为她逃离了他。Hiroto 只是说，因为发生的事他很害怕，不知道该怎么办。高木涉把佐藤美和子丢失的警察证还给了她，而佐藤美和子之所以失望，真正的原因就是因为那张丢失的警察证。
motive.en: Shiga's sister had jumped into traffic in order to get away from her stalker, Hiroto, and was hit by a car. Despite her death he kept photos that he took when stalking her, and in front of these photos he blamed Mika for dying because she ran away from him. Hiroto simply said that he scared because of what happened and he did not know what to do. Takagi gives back Sato's lost badge to her, and the real reason why Sato got disappointed is because of the lost badge.

method.zhHans: 他欺骗了 Noriya 的时间感，以帮助确立自己的不在场证明。
method.en: He had tricked Noriya's sense of time to help prove his alibi.

evidence.zhHans: 他欺骗了 Noriya 的时间感，以帮助确立自己的不在场证明。Yumi 和千叶和伸向佐藤美和子打招呼，并发现这一切都是一场误会。
evidence.en: He had tricked Noriya's sense of time to help prove his alibi. Yumi and Chiba greeted Sato and found out it was all a misunderstanding.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Toshinari Shiga。他欺骗了 Noriya 的时间感，以帮助确立自己的不在场证明。动机是 Hiroto 跟踪 Mika，从而导致了她的死亡。Shiga 的妹妹为了摆脱跟踪她的 Hiroto 而冲进车流，被车撞死。如果 Hiroto 叫了救护车，并告诉他们她在哪，她或许能活下来。
resolution.en: The culprit is Toshinari Shiga. He had tricked Noriya's sense of time to help prove his alibi. The motive was that Hiroto was stalking Mika which caused her death. Shiga's sister had jumped into traffic in order to get away from her stalker, Hiroto, and was hit by a car. If Hiroto had called for an ambulance, and told them where she was she might've lived.

summary.en: While at the parking lot, Sato was disappointed at something because it might be embarrassing, while Takagi said that he will take responsibility. Yumi and Naeko overheard and thought that Sato is pregnant.
